title: REQ · Worker detects scheduled and closed Rounds via a Git interface and closes expired Rounds with an immutable snapshot
summary: Round poller over a mockable Git interface that closes expired Rounds and freezes contributions in the backend snapshot format
description: Context: backend round.Service.Close writes snapshot.yaml (Snapshot/SnapshotEntry, mode 0444, never overwritten), records HEAD as freeze_commit and moves to CLOSED. Desired behavior: rounds.Poller pulls through a Git interface, lists worlds/<world>/rounds/*/round.yaml, reports SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds and closes OPEN Rounds whose EndsAt is not after the injected clock. Expected result: identical snapshot contract. Why: the Worker must close Rounds even when the backend is down.
acceptance_criteria: Given Rounds in SCHEDULED, OPEN and CLOSED status, when Detect runs, then scheduled and closed lists are returned

Given an OPEN Round with EndsAt <= fake now, when CloseExpired runs, then snapshot.yaml exists with mode 0444, Git Commit and Head are called, and round.yaml has status CLOSED, freeze_commit and closed_at
Given an existing snapshot.yaml, when CloseExpired runs, then it is not overwritten and an error is returned
Given an OPEN Round not yet expired, when CloseExpired runs, then nothing changes

out_of_scope: Git CLI implementation details beyond the interface
preserve: Backend snapshot.yaml field names: round, world, frozen_at, contributions[id, player, created_at, prompt_sha256]

technical_constraints: Git interface: Pull, Commit, Head, Contributions; clock injected
definition_of_done: Poller and closer implemented per contract
